s0301.literal: Two inspectors were added to the Central Secretariat.
s0301.idiomatic: Two inspectors were added to the central secretariat.

s0302.literal: Public levies for Dadu this year were remitted.
s0302.idiomatic: Public levies for Dadu this year were remitted.

s0303.literal: One thousand garrison-farm troops at Shangdu were added; farm implements and five thousand ingots of notes for cattle prices were supplied; Mubalashi was ordered to supervise them.
s0303.idiomatic: 1,000 garrison-farm troops at Shangdu were added; farm implements and 5,000 ingots of notes for cattle prices were supplied; Mubalashi was ordered to supervise them.

s0304.literal: An edict ordered that the people of Zhisumieli and Guiman be placed under the Household of the Heir Apparent.
s0304.idiomatic: An edict ordered that the people of Zhisumieli and Guiman be placed under the Household of the Heir Apparent.

s0305.literal: On renchen day the moon transgressed Net.
s0305.idiomatic: On renchen day the moon transgressed Net.

s0306.literal: On bingshen day the presentation of a hawk by Jiang-Huai Branch Privy Council official Bulinjidai was refused; an edict also ordered that from now on military officers were forbidden to hunt and disturb the people; violators would be prosecuted.
s0306.idiomatic: On bingshen day the presentation of a hawk by Jiang-Huai branch privy council official Bulinjidai was refused; an edict also ordered that from now on military officers were forbidden to hunt and disturb the people; violators would be prosecuted.

s0307.literal: On dingyou day the Muslim Bekmahmosha and others presented large pearls, asking several tens of thousands of ingots of notes in payment; the Emperor said: "What are pearls for!
s0307.idiomatic: On dingyou day the Muslim Bekmahmosha and others presented large pearls, asking several tens of thousands of ingots of notes in payment; the Emperor said, "What are pearls for!

s0308.literal: That money should be kept to aid the poor.
s0308.idiomatic: That money should be kept to aid the poor.

s0309.literal: " An order granted one hundred thousand shi of sea-transported grain to the garrison troops at Liaoyang, and also instructed the province official Xuechegan to have the Qincha under Botiemute farm and fish to support themselves; grain need not be supplied.
s0309.idiomatic: An order granted 100,000 shi of sea-transported grain to the garrison troops at Liaoyang, and also instructed the province official Xuechegan to have the Qincha under Botiemute farm and fish to support themselves; grain need not be supplied.

s0310.literal: On jiachen day Central Secretariat officials said: "Among attendants who transmitted imperial orders granting appointments, seventy persons in all — we now wish to further sort and select them; those who are unsuitable we dare not appoint by edict.
s0310.idiomatic: On jiachen day central secretariat officials said, "Among attendants who transmitted imperial orders granting appointments, 70 persons in all — we now wish to further sort and select them; those who are unsuitable we dare not appoint by edict.

s0311.literal: " The Emperor said: "For the most part these were not my words — whenever someone came to memorialize, I only told you to consider whether they were usable or not; you yourselves should decide."
s0311.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "For the most part these were not my words — whenever someone came to memorialize, I only told you to consider whether they were usable or not; you yourselves should decide."

s0312.literal: " They also said: "This year provisions for Shangdu, Dadu, Ganzhou, and Xijing involve vast expenses; from now on all rewards and grants should for the time being be suspended.
s0312.idiomatic: They also said, "This year provisions for Shangdu, Dadu, Ganzhou, and Xijing involve vast expenses; from now on all rewards and grants should for the time being be suspended.

s0314.literal: On yisi day Mars transgressed Heavenly Street.
s0314.idiomatic: On yisi day Mars transgressed Heavenly Street.

s0315.literal: On dingwei day the imperial carriage proceeded to Shangdu.
s0315.idiomatic: On dingwei day the imperial carriage proceeded to Shangdu.

s0316.literal: The newly submitted cave Miao Wu Donga was made military-civil official of Tanxi and other places, bearing a gold tally.
s0316.idiomatic: The newly submitted cave Miao Wu Donga was made military-civil official of Tanxi and other places, bearing a gold tally.

s0317.literal: Three hundred newly submitted troops were granted ten ingots of notes each and garrison-farmed at Zhending.
s0317.idiomatic: 300 newly submitted troops were granted 10 ingots of notes each and garrison-farmed at Zhending.

s0318.literal: On gengxu day the moon transgressed Ox.
s0318.idiomatic: On gengxu day the moon transgressed Ox.

s0319.literal: On xinhai day an edict ordered three thousand troops under Marshal Wang Weihe dispatched to campaign against the Tubo; ten thousand troops from Shaanxi and Sichuan were also dispatched, under branch privy council officer Ming'andai'er, to campaign against the Xifan.
s0319.idiomatic: On xinhai day an edict ordered 3,000 troops under Marshal Wang Weihe dispatched to campaign against the Tubo; 10,000 troops from Shaanxi and Sichuan were also dispatched, under branch privy council officer Ming'andai'er, to campaign against the Xifan.

s0320.literal: An order directed that because Shao and Gan were far apart, one branch privy council official from Ganzhou was assigned to garrison Shaozhou.
s0320.idiomatic: An order directed that because Shao and Gan were far apart, one branch privy council official from Ganzhou was assigned to garrison Shaozhou.

s0321.literal: The Yunnan Branch Censorate was re-established.
s0321.idiomatic: The Yunnan branch censorate was re-established.

s0322.literal: An edict ordered water relay stations established along the coast — eleven in all from Tamna to the mouth of the Yalu River — under the supervision of Hong Junxiang.
s0322.idiomatic: An edict ordered water relay stations established along the coast — 11 in all from Tamna to the mouth of the Yalu River — under the supervision of Hong Junxiang.

s0323.literal: On guichou day Venus transgressed Encampment.
s0323.idiomatic: On guichou day Venus transgressed Encampment.

s0324.literal: The Jiangxi branch privy council official Yuedimishi said: "In Jiangnan many powerful families shelter bandits; the ringleaders should be executed, the rest relocated to inner counties.
s0324.idiomatic: The Jiangxi branch privy council official Yuedimishi said, "In Jiangnan many powerful families shelter bandits; the ringleaders should be executed, the rest relocated to inner counties.

s0326.literal: The prohibition on weapons in Jiangnan was strictly enforced.
s0326.idiomatic: The prohibition on weapons in Jiangnan was strictly enforced.

s0327.literal: Third month, gengshen day: Vice Director of the Privy Council Zhasan was made Director of the Privy Council; Grand Councillor Fan Wenhua was ordered to supervise dredging the grain canal.
s0327.idiomatic: Third month, gengshen day: Vice Director of the Privy Council Zhasan was made Director of the Privy Council; Grand Councillor Fan Wenhua was ordered to supervise dredging the grain canal.

s0328.literal: Grand Councillor Li Ting led the troops escorting the procession to Shangdu.
s0328.idiomatic: Grand Councillor Li Ting led the troops escorting the procession to Shangdu.

s0329.literal: Rain damaged the capital city; an edict ordered thirty thousand guard troops dispatched to repair it, and directed the Central Secretariat to pay their wages.
s0329.idiomatic: Rain damaged the capital city; an edict ordered 30,000 guard troops dispatched to repair it, and directed the central secretariat to pay their wages.

s0330.literal: On jiazi day horses throughout the realm were registered to the number of one hundred thousand.
s0330.idiomatic: On jiazi day horses throughout the realm were registered to the number of 100,000.

s0331.literal: On jisi day the Branch Grand Agriculture Commission was established.
s0331.idiomatic: On jisi day the branch grand agriculture commission was established.

s0332.literal: The Hongze and Shaobo garrison farms had formerly been entrusted to four ten-thousand-household offices; an edict retained two of them and established twenty civilian colonies.
s0332.idiomatic: The Hongze and Shaobo garrison farms had formerly been entrusted to four ten-thousand-household offices; an edict retained two of them and established 20 civilian colonies.

s0333.literal: On xinwei day the moon transgressed Root.
s0333.idiomatic: On xinwei day the moon transgressed Root.

s0334.literal: Summer, fourth month, jihai day: Branch Grand Agriculture Commissioner Yan Gongnan and Hanlin Academician Grand Preceptor Liu Mengyan said: "Maritime trade bureaus have been established at seven places — Hangzhou, Shanghai, Kanpu, Wenzhou, Qingyuan, Guangdong, and Quanzhou; only at Quanzhou are goods taxed one in thirty, while the rest levy one in fifteen; we request Quanzhou's rate be made the standard.
s0334.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, jihai day: Branch Grand Agriculture Commissioner Yan Gongnan and Hanlin Academician Grand Preceptor Liu Mengyan said, "Maritime trade bureaus have been established at seven places — Hangzhou, Shanghai, Kanpu, Wenzhou, Qingyuan, Guangdong, and Quanzhou; only at Quanzhou are goods taxed one in thirty, while the rest levy one in fifteen; we request Quanzhou's rate be made the standard.

s0336.literal: The Wenzhou maritime bureau was also merged into Qingyuan, and the Hangzhou maritime bureau into the tax office.
s0336.idiomatic: The Wenzhou maritime bureau was also merged into Qingyuan, and the Hangzhou maritime bureau into the tax office.

s0337.literal: The Jiangnan Branch Grand Agriculture Commission moved from Pingjiang to Yangzhou, concurrently overseeing agricultural affairs in the two Huai regions.
s0337.idiomatic: The Jiangnan branch grand agriculture commission moved from Pingjiang to Yangzhou, concurrently overseeing agricultural affairs in the two Huai regions.

s0338.literal: In Bafan province, prefecture and county officials were re-established; the Huizhou record-keeping office was abolished.
s0338.idiomatic: In Bafan province, prefecture and county officials were re-established; the Huizhou record-keeping office was abolished.

s0339.literal: An inner secretariat was established for Imperial Grandson, Prince of Jin.
s0339.idiomatic: An inner secretariat was established for Imperial Grandson, Prince of Jin.

s0340.literal: An edict ordered that from now on all offices of second rank and above were to exchange official correspondence with the various ministries.
s0340.idiomatic: An edict ordered that from now on all offices of second rank and above were to exchange official correspondence with the various ministries.

s0341.literal: For the twenty-four cities of Gongchang, in accordance with the former precedent two persons were to be selected from among the Wang clan brothers, sons, and nephews of the marshal.
s0341.idiomatic: For the 24 cities of Gongchang, in accordance with the former precedent two persons were to be selected from among the Wang clan brothers, sons, and nephews of the marshal.

s0342.literal: On renyin day privy council officials said: "Last year twenty thousand troops were levied for the Java campaign, each given two ingots of notes; afterward only five thousand went; the originally issued thirty thousand ingots should be recovered for the treasury.
s0342.idiomatic: On renyin day privy council officials said, "Last year 20,000 troops were levied for the Java campaign, each given two ingots of notes; afterward only 5,000 went; the originally issued 30,000 ingots should be recovered for the treasury.

s0343.literal: " The Emperor said: "It was not that the men would not go — I myself halted it; do not recover them."
s0343.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "It was not that the men would not go — I myself halted it; do not recover them."

s0344.literal: On guichou day Venus transgressed Earth Star.
s0344.idiomatic: On guichou day Venus transgressed Earth Star.

s0345.literal: The Guangdong Rectification and Anti-Corruption Surveillance Commission again administered Guangzhou.
s0345.idiomatic: The Guangdong rectification and anti-corruption surveillance commission again administered Guangzhou.

s0346.literal: On jiayin day an edict ordered envoys dispatched to summon and instruct Siam.
s0346.idiomatic: On jiayin day an edict ordered envoys dispatched to summon and instruct Siam.

s0347.literal: Woluosi requested that the Bafan enrolled households of Hesi and Bo be placed under his joint administration, that the pacification commission headquarters be moved to govern Chen, Yuan, and Jing prefectures, and that beyond regular levies three thousand ingots of notes be paid annually; this was not approved.
s0347.idiomatic: Woluosi requested that the Bafan enrolled households of Hesi and Bo be placed under his joint administration, that the pacification commission headquarters be moved to govern Chen, Yuan, and Jing prefectures, and that beyond regular levies 3,000 ingots of notes be paid annually; this was not approved.

s0348.literal: Twelve persons including Guang Prefecture barbarian Guang Long, twenty-eight including Bangya Wang Wenxian, sixteen including Jinzhu Prefecture Ma Lin, fifty-four including Dalong tribe Tuluhu, ninety including Yongshun Route Peng Shiqiang, thirteen including Anhua Prefecture Wu Zairong, and four including Shibi Sanmao cave Goudashi Wang — each was granted a barbarian official post, bestowed an imperial edict, and sent home.
s0348.idiomatic: 12 persons including Guang Prefecture barbarian Guang Long, 28 including Bangya Wang Wenxian, 16 including Jinzhu Prefecture Ma Lin, 54 including Dalong tribe Tuluhu, 90 including Yongshun Route Peng Shiqiang, 13 including Anhua Prefecture Wu Zairong, and 4 including Shibi Sanmao cave Goudashi Wang — each was granted a barbarian official post, bestowed an imperial edict, and sent home.

s0349.literal: An order directed that in Jiangnan the shrines to the Sacred Ancestor and Heavenly Lord at various Daoist monasteries be demolished.
s0349.idiomatic: An order directed that in Jiangnan the shrines to the Sacred Ancestor and Heavenly Lord at various Daoist monasteries be demolished.

s0350.literal: Fifth month, bingchen new moon: ten thousand horses were granted to the rotating guard units of the four divisions; four hundred horses were also granted to their interpreters.
s0350.idiomatic: Fifth month, bingchen new moon: 10,000 horses were granted to the rotating guard units of the four divisions; 400 horses were also granted to their interpreters.

s0351.literal: On renxu day the chieftain of the Dingyun cave Miao came and submitted.
s0351.idiomatic: On renxu day the chieftain of the Dingyun cave Miao came and submitted.

s0352.literal: On guihai day tattooed-hand troops of the fallen Song in Hesi, Bo, and other places were registered.
s0352.idiomatic: On guihai day tattooed-hand troops of the fallen Song in Hesi, Bo, and other places were registered.

s0353.literal: On bingyin day an edict ordered officials delegated jointly with branch secretariat officials to review and verify barbarian military-civil officials.
s0353.idiomatic: On bingyin day an edict ordered officials delegated jointly with branch secretariat officials to review and verify barbarian military-civil officials.

s0354.literal: Because the people of Jiangnan resented Yang Lianzhenjiao, his son Anpu, left vice chancellor of the Zhejiang branch secretariat, was dismissed.
s0354.idiomatic: Because the people of Jiangnan resented Yang Lianzhenjiao, his son Anpu, left vice chancellor of the Zhejiang branch secretariat, was dismissed.

s0355.literal: An edict noted that flooding in western Zhejiang had inundated fields as a disaster, and ordered wealthy households to hire tenant farmers to dredge waterways.
s0355.idiomatic: An edict noted that flooding in western Zhejiang had inundated fields as a disaster, and ordered wealthy households to hire tenant farmers to dredge waterways.

s0356.literal: On xinwei day an order directed that guesthouses at Buddhist monasteries where merchants lodged — their goods were to be taxed according to regulation.
s0356.idiomatic: On xinwei day an order directed that guesthouses at Buddhist monasteries where merchants lodged — their goods were to be taxed according to regulation.

s0357.literal: On dingchou day Central Secretariat officials said: "At Shangdu there are two thousand nine hundred ninety-nine artisan households, consuming over fifteen thousand two hundred shi of official grain annually; those not urgently needed should be selected and sent to be fed at Dadu.
s0357.idiomatic: On dingchou day central secretariat officials said, "At Shangdu there are 2,999 artisan households, consuming over 15,200 shi of official grain annually; those not urgently needed should be selected and sent to be fed at Dadu.

s0359.literal: On jiashen day flooding struck Jing'an County, Shen Prefecture, Zhending Route; the people suffered famine; two thousand five hundred seventy-four shi of relief grain from the charity granary was issued.
s0359.idiomatic: On jiashen day flooding struck Jing'an County, Shen Prefecture, Zhending Route; the people suffered famine; 2,574 shi of relief grain from the charity granary was issued.

s0360.literal: Sixth month, bingxu day: an order selected eight hundred elite troops from the Hexi hostage army, supplied armor, saddles, and fur garments, and dispatched them to Imperial Grandson Ananda's command for campaign.
s0360.idiomatic: Sixth month, bingxu day: an order selected 800 elite troops from the Hexi hostage army, supplied armor, saddles, and fur garments, and dispatched them to Imperial Grandson Ananda's command for campaign.

s0361.literal: On jichou day Jupiter transgressed Left Enforcer.
s0361.idiomatic: On jichou day Jupiter transgressed Left Enforcer.

s0362.literal: On gengyin day an edict ordered that Dandang in Yunnan remain under the Xifan Pacification Commission.
s0362.idiomatic: On gengyin day an edict ordered that Dandang in Yunnan remain under the Xifan Pacification Commission.

s0363.literal: Qi, Huang, and other routes of Huai West were changed to fall under the Henan-Jiangbei Branch Secretariat.
s0363.idiomatic: Qi, Huang, and other routes of Huai West were changed to fall under the Henan-Jiangbei branch secretariat.

s0364.literal: On bingshen day the moon transgressed Dipper.
s0364.idiomatic: On bingshen day the moon transgressed Dipper.

s0365.literal: On yisi day the heir apparent's seal was granted to Imperial Grandson Temür to command troops on the northern frontier.
s0365.idiomatic: On yisi day the heir apparent's seal was granted to Imperial Grandson Temür to command troops on the northern frontier.

s0366.literal: On jiyou day an edict ordered Lake Tai dredged.
s0366.idiomatic: On jiyou day an edict ordered Lake Tai dredged.

s0367.literal: On renzi day locusts struck Daxing County;
s0367.idiomatic: On renzi day locusts struck Daxing County;

s0368.literal: In Yizhou hail fell as large as chicken eggs.
s0368.idiomatic: In Yizhou hail fell as large as chicken eggs.

s0369.literal: Autumn, seventh month, dingsi day: one Central Secretariat official was ordered to supervise compilation of the national history.
s0369.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month, dingsi day: one central secretariat official was ordered to supervise compilation of the national history.

s0370.literal: On jiwei day an edict ordered Imperial Great-Grandson Songshan to go out and garrison Yunnan; the Prince of Liang seal was granted him.
s0370.idiomatic: On jiwei day an edict ordered Imperial Great-Grandson Songshan to go out and garrison Yunnan; the Prince of Liang seal was granted him.

s0371.literal: An edict remitted Fujian's annual tribute of leather goods and Quanzhou's woven ramie silk.
s0371.idiomatic: An edict remitted Fujian's annual tribute of leather goods and Quanzhou's woven ramie silk.

s0372.literal: On gengshen day Prefect of Heqing Xibaoshi was ordered to carry an imperial edict summoning and instructing the unsubmitting Miao stockades of Nongshun.
s0372.idiomatic: On gengshen day Prefect of Heqing Xibaoshi was ordered to carry an imperial edict summoning and instructing the unsubmitting Miao stockades of Nongshun.

s0373.literal: On jiazi day the moon transgressed Establishment.
s0373.idiomatic: On jiazi day the moon transgressed Establishment.

s0374.literal: On jisi day Liu Guojie was ordered to follow Prince Yijili in directing the armies campaigning against Jiaozhi.
s0374.idiomatic: On jisi day Liu Guojie was ordered to follow Prince Yijili in directing the armies campaigning against Jiaozhi.

s0375.literal: Ten thousand shi of arrears in rent from Yunnan garrison-farm troops was remitted.
s0375.idiomatic: 10,000 shi of arrears in rent from Yunnan garrison-farm troops was remitted.

s0376.literal: On renshen day Yueshachai'er was made Director of the Privy Council.
s0376.idiomatic: On renshen day Yueshachai'er was made Director of the Privy Council.

s0377.literal: On dingchou day the newly opened grain canal was granted the name Tonghui.
s0377.idiomatic: On dingchou day the newly opened grain canal was granted the name Tonghui.

s0378.literal: On renshen day seven hundred Qirqis households eliminated by Zhierhehu were garrison-farmed in Hesihe lands.
s0378.idiomatic: On renshen day 700 Qirqis households eliminated by Zhierhehu were garrison-farmed in Hesihe lands.

s0379.literal: On xinsi day the moon transgressed Ghost.
s0379.idiomatic: On xinsi day the moon transgressed Ghost.

s0380.literal: Eighth month, bingxu day: abandoned fields everywhere without registered owners were registered; emancipated persons, unregistered persons, and the like were ordered to garrison-farm them.
s0380.idiomatic: Eighth month, bingxu day: abandoned fields everywhere without registered owners were registered; emancipated persons, unregistered persons, and the like were ordered to garrison-farm them.

s0381.literal: On gengyin day envoys to Annam Liang Zeng and Chen Fu returned with Annamese envoys Tao Ziqi and Liang Wenzao.
s0381.idiomatic: On gengyin day envoys to Annam Liang Zeng and Chen Fu returned with Annamese envoys Tao Ziqi and Liang Wenzao.

s0382.literal: An order directed the Fujian branch secretariat to release the Java campaign troops to return home.
s0382.idiomatic: An order directed the Fujian branch secretariat to release the Java campaign troops to return home.

s0383.literal: On jiawu day Mercury transgressed the Western Wall Upper General of Supreme Palace Enclosure.
s0383.idiomatic: On jiawu day Mercury transgressed the Western Wall Upper General of Supreme Palace Enclosure.

s0384.literal: On wuxu day a judicial seal was granted to the Anxi Princely Establishment.
s0384.idiomatic: On wuxu day a judicial seal was granted to the Anxi princely establishment.

s0385.literal: On jiachen day the moon transgressed Net.
s0385.idiomatic: On jiachen day the moon transgressed Net.

s0386.literal: On dingwei day Huguang branch secretariat officials said Hainan and Haibei had much uncultivated land suitable for garrison farms; an edict established the Haibei-Hainan Garrison-farm Ten-thousand-household Office for guarding the Li Miao to supervise it.
s0386.idiomatic: On dingwei day Huguang branch secretariat officials said Hainan and Haibei had much uncultivated land suitable for garrison farms; an edict established the Haibei-Hainan garrison-farm ten-thousand-household office for guarding the Li Miao to supervise it.

s0387.literal: On wushen day the moon transgressed Ghost.
s0387.idiomatic: On wushen day the moon transgressed Ghost.

s0388.literal: One hundred seventy-seven qing of garrison fields under the Military Colonies supervisory office were inundated; four thousand seven hundred seventy-two shi of rent was remitted.
s0388.idiomatic: 177 qing of garrison fields under the military colonies supervisory office were inundated; 4,772 shi of rent was remitted.

s0389.literal: Ninth month, guichou new moon: the great carriage returned from Shangdu.
s0389.idiomatic: Ninth month, guichou new moon: the great carriage returned from Shangdu.

s0390.literal: On wuwu day an order directed that darughachi and chief prefects of each route were to oversee relay affairs.
s0390.idiomatic: On wuwu day an order directed that darughachi and chief prefects of each route were to oversee relay affairs.

s0391.literal: On jiwei day Ming'andai'er, leading ten thousand troops campaigning against the Tubo, had recently sent envoys requesting that stockade officials of Mao Prefecture who had earlier submitted be brought to court; this was not approved.
s0391.idiomatic: On jiwei day Ming'andai'er, leading 10,000 troops campaigning against the Tubo, had recently sent envoys requesting that stockade officials of Mao Prefecture who had earlier submitted be brought to court; this was not approved.

s0392.literal: On yichou day the Haibei-Hainan Trade supervisory office was established; taxes followed the maritime trade bureau precedent.
s0392.idiomatic: On yichou day the Haibei-Hainan trade supervisory office was established; taxes followed the maritime trade bureau precedent.

s0393.literal: On bingyin day Jinchi people were sent back.
s0393.idiomatic: On bingyin day Jinchi people were sent back.

s0394.literal: On dingmao day the moon transgressed Net.
s0394.idiomatic: On dingmao day the moon transgressed Net.

s0395.literal: On guiyou day an order directed that fifty thousand ingots of notes from censorate confiscations and fines be granted to impoverished guards.
s0395.idiomatic: On guiyou day an order directed that 50,000 ingots of notes from censorate confiscations and fines be granted to impoverished guards.

s0396.literal: On xinsi day locusts struck Deng Prefecture and flooding struck En Prefecture; the people lacked food; over five thousand nine hundred shi of rice from charity granaries was issued in relief.
s0396.idiomatic: On xinsi day locusts struck Deng Prefecture and flooding struck En Prefecture; the people lacked food; over 5,900 shi of rice from charity granaries was issued in relief.

s0397.literal: Winter, tenth month, guiwei new moon: Guard close-attendant army commander Zhang Bangrui was made ten-thousand-household commander, bearing a tiger tally, leading one thousand Liupanshan troops together with armies of Prince Xiping and others totaling ten thousand men on a western campaign.
s0397.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, guiwei new moon: Guard close-attendant army commander Zhang Bangrui was made ten-thousand-household commander, bearing a tiger tally, leading 1,000 Liupanshan troops together with armies of Prince Xiping and others totaling 10,000 men on a western campaign.

s0398.literal: Garments one set each were granted to army officers supervising dredging at Guancheng;
s0398.idiomatic: Garments one set each were granted to army officers supervising dredging at Guancheng;

s0399.literal: Winter garments were granted to seventeen persons including Jiaozhi's Tao Ziqi, who were settled in Jingnan.
s0399.idiomatic: Winter garments were granted to 17 persons including Jiaozhi's Tao Ziqi, who were settled in Jingnan.

s0400.literal: On wuzi day an edict ordered the Bian embankments repaired.
s0400.idiomatic: On wuzi day an edict ordered the Bian embankments repaired.
